about: Labelled eval set for tools/eval_thresholds.py (NOBLIVION-33, NOBLIVION-48). Made-up developer memories only. 'recall' feeds the prompt recall floor (note text, no config file) and the ranked index floor (the shipped config file) and, with 'error_queries', the error recall store floor (store mode) and local floor (local mode, the default). 'dedup' feeds the dedup cosine: 'duplicates' lists the pairs that say the same thing; every other pair in the dedup folder is a non-duplicate. The set is small and has no held-out split: each threshold is chosen and scored on the same items.

memories.name: tests use the project venv
memories.description: The system python has no pytest; run tests with the project venv.
memories.body: Run `uv run pytest` or `.venv/bin/python -m pytest`. Never call the system python for tests: it fails with 'No module named pytest'.

memories.name: rebase on main before a push
memories.description: Rebase a feature branch on the current main before you push it.
memories.body: Run `git fetch origin`, then `git rebase origin/main`, then push. The pull request then has no merge commits.

memories.name: never force-push main
memories.description: A force-push to main rewrites shared history.
memories.body: Never run `git push --force` on main. Use `--force-with-lease` on your own feature branch only.

memories.name: deploy to staging before production
memories.description: Every release goes to staging first.
memories.body: Deploy to staging.example.com first. Watch its health page for ten minutes, then deploy to app.example.com.

memories.name: back up the database before a migration
memories.description: Take a dump of the production database before a schema migration.
memories.body: Run pg_dump on the production database before you run a schema migration. Keep the dump for seven days.

memories.name: the editor strips trailing whitespace
memories.description: Whitespace-only diff lines come from the editor config.
memories.body: The editor config removes trailing whitespace on save. A diff that only changes whitespace comes from that; keep it out of unrelated commits.

memories.name: Makefile recipes need tabs
memories.description: A Makefile recipe line must start with a tab.
memories.body: make fails with 'missing separator' when a recipe line starts with spaces. Turn off tab expansion for Makefiles in the editor.

memories.name: run the linter before a commit
memories.description: Run ruff check and ruff format before every commit.
memories.body: CI fails on a lint error such as an unused import, and a red build costs ten minutes. Run `ruff check .` and `ruff format .` first.

memories.name: keep secrets out of git
memories.description: API keys live in the .env file, which git ignores.
memories.body: Put every API key in .env. The file is in .gitignore. Never commit a key; rotate it at once if it leaks.

memories.name: do not retry flaky tests blindly
memories.description: A test that fails only sometimes hides a race.
memories.body: Find the cause of an intermittent test failure. Do not add a retry decorator to make it pass.

memories.name: order Dockerfile layers for the cache
memories.description: Install dependencies before you copy the source.
memories.body: Copy the lock file and install the dependencies before you copy the source code. Then a code change does not reinstall every package.

memories.name: use the SSH alias for the build server
memories.description: Connect to the build server with the ssh alias.
memories.body: Run `ssh build`. The alias in ~/.ssh/config points at build.example.com, port 2222, with the deploy key.

memories.name: store times in UTC
memories.description: Every timestamp in the database is UTC.
memories.body: Write timestamps to the database in UTC. Convert to the local time zone only in the user interface.

memories.name: production logs at info level
memories.description: Debug logging in production fills the disk.
memories.body: Set LOG_LEVEL=info on app.example.com. Debug logs filled the log disk in one day.

memories.name: keep pull requests small
memories.description: One pull request changes one thing.
memories.body: Keep a pull request under 400 changed lines, so a reviewer can read it in one sitting.

memories.name: commit message style
memories.description: Imperative subject under 72 characters, the why in the body.
memories.body: Write the commit subject in the imperative mood and under 72 characters. Explain why the change is needed in the body.

memories.name: use the Node version from .nvmrc
memories.description: Run nvm use before npm install in the frontend.
memories.body: Run `nvm use` in the frontend folder before `npm install`. The wrong Node version rewrites package-lock.json and fails the engine check.

memories.name: port 8080 already in use
memories.description: The dev server fails when an old run still holds the port.
memories.body: The local dev server fails with 'address already in use' when an old run is still alive. Find it with `lsof -i :8080` and stop it.

memories.name: cron runs in UTC
memories.description: The scheduled jobs on the worker run in UTC.
memories.body: The cron jobs on worker.example.com run in UTC, not local time. Write each schedule in UTC.

memories.name: pin dependencies with a lock file
memories.description: Commit the lock file; update dependencies on purpose.
memories.body: Commit the lock file. Upgrade libraries in their own pull request, never as a side effect of a bug fix.

memories.name: review comments name the code
memories.description: Comment on the code, not the person.
memories.body: Write 'this function returns None on error', not 'you forgot'. Suggest a fix with each review comment.

memories.name: remove feature flags after rollout
memories.description: A flag that is on for everyone is dead code.
memories.body: When a feature flag has been on for every user for a month, remove the flag and the old code path.

memories.name: check the query plan for a slow query
memories.description: Run EXPLAIN ANALYZE before you add an index.
memories.body: Run EXPLAIN ANALYZE on a slow query first. Add an index only when the plan shows a sequential scan on a large table.

memories.name: type hints on public functions
memories.description: Every public function has type hints; mypy runs in CI.
memories.body: Annotate the parameters and return type of every public function. mypy in CI catches a wrong call before review.

memories.name: save a root-owned file from vim
memories.description: Write a read-only file from vim with sudo tee.
memories.body: When vim cannot write a file owned by root (E212), run `:w !sudo tee %` instead of quitting and losing the edit.

memories.name: run long jobs in tmux
memories.description: A dropped SSH connection must not kill a long job.
memories.body: Start a long migration or backup inside tmux on the server. Reattach with `tmux attach` after the connection drops.

memories.name: Docker fills the build disk
memories.description: Old images and build cache fill the build host disk.
memories.body: When the build host reports 'no space left on device', run `docker system prune` to remove old images and build cache.

memories.name: TLS certificates renew by certbot
memories.description: The certificate for example.com renews automatically.
memories.body: certbot renews the TLS certificate of example.com every 60 days. When a browser says the certificate has expired, check the certbot timer.

memories.name: use git bisect for a regression
memories.description: Find the commit that broke a feature with git bisect.
memories.body: When a bug appeared between two releases, run `git bisect run` with a test script to find the first bad commit.

memories.name: tests write files under tmp_path
memories.description: Tests never write into the repo or the home folder.
memories.body: A test writes files only under the pytest tmp_path fixture, never in the repository or the home folder.

memories.name: environment variable names
memories.description: Prefix every setting with APP_.
memories.body: Name every configuration variable with the APP_ prefix, for example APP_DATABASE_URL, so it does not clash with system variables.

memories.name: test the restore, not only the backup
memories.description: Restore a backup once a month to prove it works.
memories.body: Once a month, restore last night's backup into a scratch database and run the smoke tests against it.

memories.name: push rejected because the remote has new work
memories.description: git push rejected with fetch first: pull with rebase.
memories.body: When git push says 'Updates were rejected because the remote contains work that you do not have locally', run `git pull --rebase`, then push again.

memories.name: SSH permission denied (publickey)
memories.description: The deploy key is not loaded in the agent.
memories.body: 'Permission denied (publickey)' from build.example.com means the deploy key is not loaded. Run `ssh-add ~/.ssh/deploy_key` and retry.

memories.name: npm ERESOLVE dependency conflict
memories.description: npm cannot resolve the dependency tree when a peer version does not match.
memories.body: npm install fails with 'ERESOLVE unable to resolve dependency tree' when a peer dependency version does not match. Fix the version; do not use --force.

memories.name: circular import error
memories.description: Two modules import each other.
memories.body: 'cannot import name ... from partially initialized module' means a circular import. Move the shared code into a third module.

memories.name: run pytest with the venv
memories.description: The system python lacks pytest.
memories.body: Use the project venv python to run the tests. The system python3 has no pytest.

memories.name: tests need the project environment
memories.description: Do not call the system python3 for pytest.
memories.body: pytest is not installed for the system interpreter. Run `.venv/bin/python -m pytest` from the project folder.

memories.name: recreate the venv after a Python upgrade
memories.description: A Python upgrade breaks the old venv.
memories.body: After the system Python is upgraded, delete .venv and create it again with `uv sync`.

memories.name: staging before production
memories.description: Every release goes to staging first.
memories.body: Deploy each release to staging.example.com and check it before it goes to production.

memories.name: never deploy straight to production
memories.description: Production deploys come after a staging check.
memories.body: A build reaches app.example.com only after it ran on the staging server and passed the health check there.

memories.name: roll back with the previous image tag
memories.description: A bad deploy is undone by the previous tag.
memories.body: To roll back production, deploy the image tag of the previous release. Do not rebuild from an old commit.

memories.name: no force-push on main
memories.description: Force-pushing main rewrites shared history.
memories.body: Never force-push the main branch.

memories.name: main history is never rewritten
memories.description: Do not run git push --force against main.
memories.body: Other people build on main, so a forced push there breaks their clones. Only force-push your own branch, with --force-with-lease.

memories.name: delete merged branches
memories.description: Remove a feature branch once it is merged.
memories.body: After a pull request is merged, delete its branch on the remote and locally.

memories.name: timestamps in UTC
memories.description: Store every database timestamp in UTC.
memories.body: All times in the database are UTC.

memories.name: the database keeps UTC time
memories.description: Convert to local time only for display.
memories.body: Save datetimes as UTC in the tables. The user interface converts them to the local zone.

memories.name: show dates in the user's locale
memories.description: Format dates with the user's locale settings.
memories.body: The interface formats dates with the browser locale, for example 31/12/2026 or 12/31/2026.

memories.name: commit the lock file
memories.description: The dependency lock file is part of the repository.
memories.body: Always commit the lock file together with the dependency change.

memories.name: keep the lock file in git
memories.description: Pinned dependency versions belong in version control.
memories.body: Check the lock file into git, so every machine installs the same dependency versions.

memories.name: run the dependency audit weekly
memories.description: Scan dependencies for known vulnerabilities.
memories.body: Every Monday run the dependency audit and file a ticket for each high finding.

memories.name: small pull requests
memories.description: Keep each pull request small.
memories.body: A pull request changes one thing and stays under 400 lines.

memories.name: split large changes
memories.description: Split a big change into several reviewable pull requests.
memories.body: Break a large change into small pull requests that a reviewer can read in one sitting.

memories.name: two reviewers for a pull request
memories.description: Each pull request needs two approvals.
memories.body: Ask two people to review every pull request before it is merged.

memories.name: long jobs in tmux
memories.description: Run long server jobs inside tmux.
memories.body: Start long jobs on the server inside tmux, so they survive a dropped SSH connection.

memories.name: protect long tasks from SSH drops
memories.description: Use a terminal multiplexer for long remote work.
memories.body: A backup run over SSH dies when the connection drops. Run it in a tmux session and reattach later.

memories.name: tmux prefix key
memories.description: The tmux prefix is ctrl-a.
memories.body: The tmux config sets the prefix key to ctrl-a instead of ctrl-b.

memories.name: no secrets in git
memories.description: API keys never go into the repository.
memories.body: Keep API keys in the .env file, which git ignores.

memories.name: credentials stay out of version control
memories.description: Store keys in the ignored .env file.
memories.body: Never commit a password or token. Put it in .env; that file is listed in .gitignore.

memories.name: rotate API keys every 90 days
memories.description: Keys expire on a schedule.
memories.body: Rotate each API key every 90 days and update the vault entry.
